propositions: Direct prerequisites must deliver certified contracts (PlanRelationSnapshot preload with canonical IDs and relation kinds; pass3_over_findings execution_review parameter) before implementation starts, verified via upstream contract test.

Prerequisite consistency criterion runs isolated through focused finder and verifier passes, receiving only prerequisite blocks from the sole PlanRelationSnapshot preload without injecting prerequisite material into general finder/verifier/coach requests.

Every readable pinned canonical prerequisite ID receives exactly one disposition record (consistent, finding, or indeterminate with closed-enum reason code); findings carry the prerequisite_id; packing splits whole blocks into stable bins, never splitting subject or prerequisite text.

Any indeterminate prerequisite record forces unsigned top-level INDETERMINATE verdict in finalize_verdict, while DET blockers are retained visibly in the blocking array and coverage flag is passed to coach; same-text findings from different prerequisite IDs retain distinct finding IDs via length-prefixed four-field structured hash.

Singleton gold evaluation (24 focused-finder calls across eight >=3-block scenario sets) must achieve recall≥0.90, false-acceptance≤0.10, coverage=1.00, attribution-error=0.00 before packed calls are implemented; packed metrics must not regress below singleton baseline while maintaining absolute floors.

General and focused verification index domains are independently reshaped and concatenated; missing or incorrect attribution converts that prerequisite record to indeterminate/attribution-invalid and removes its incompatibility findings; context-limit splitting preserves input_index and whole plan text through all recursion.
